description: ARag integration (dual-RAG). 'connection' targets ARag's REST v1 Analyst API (GET /api/health, GET /api/v1/coverage, POST /api/v1/narrative/search, POST /api/v1/facts/lookup, POST /api/v1/answer). ARag supplies the COMPANY legs of a scenario (per-name eq:<TICKER> idiosyncratic moves) grounded in what each company discloses in its SEC 10-K/Q Risk Factors; MacroRAG supplies the macro legs (see macro.json). Set 'base_url' to the deployed ARag REST URL (its own port; must not collide with MacroRAG's :8000) and, if ARag enforces auth, the key in the env var named by 'api_key_env'. 'timeout_s' is the GENEROUS per-call ceiling (600s = 10 min) for the heavy narrative_search CPU-inference call; a call that still exceeds it is logged/documented and stops that specific scenario's generation (fail-loud, no static substitution). 'scenarios' declares, per named scenario, which services it requires (required_services, fail-loud) and the ARag company Risk-Factor queries to run. Each companies[] entry: 'ticker'; 'seed_move' (optional decimal return, e.g. -0.30 = -30%; if omitted the seed comes from the authored eq:<TICKER> driver in scenarios.json); 'narrative_query'/'section_hint'/'fiscal_years' for the Risk-Factor retrieval; and an optional 'calibration' block that deterministically scales the seed by a cited ARag fact — scaled_move = seed * clamp(1 + elasticity*(exposure - baseline), min_scale, max_scale), where for mode='share' exposure = facts_lookup(concept, dimension) / facts_lookup(denominator_concept) at fiscal_year. Where no clean fact exists (e.g. key-man, geopolitical) omit 'calibration' and ARag contributes grounding + citations only. This file is the authorable home for the scenario set: add a new named/hypothetical scenario here (+ its macro.json + scenarios.json baseline) and the runner drives the full dual-RAG process for it.

budget._comment: Run-level ARag breaker (F5): total data-call count and cumulative wall-clock ceilings across all scenarios in one run, so a runaway loop can't pound the shared inference service. timeout_s bounds a single call; this bounds the whole run. Either may be null for unlimited.
